aToB.memory: Soren respects Prof. Thorne because the scarred Dueling master notices honest work—never flattering pedigree, never ignoring cracked courtyard ward-plates, and speaking in straight lines that waste nobody's morning. When Alistair nods once at a freshly re-chalked Dueling Courtyard boundary before dawn, it counts for more than ten tournament speeches.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Soren wants to notify Prof. Thorne concisely before Dueling Class that the cracked southeast impact plate in the Dueling Courtyard has been re-seated and tested twice for high-kinetic sparks.

bToA.memory: Alistair holds Soren Lindqvist up as rare proof that Mooncrest Hall still produces steel beneath velvet: the boy checks Dueling Courtyard barrier anchors twice before sunrise, plants his boots cleanly in sparring drills, and wastes fewer words in a week than most students waste before breakfast.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Alistair wants to check briskly with Soren whether the Dueling Courtyard granite ward-plates held cleanly after Ashford's last barrage and offer him a rare, curt nod of approval on the workshop repairs.
